title: Hardware Interaction Designer
note: Early-career role asking for 1–3 years of experience; ID, interaction, HCI and creative technology backgrounds are welcome.

facts.summary: Early-career interaction designer for Oura's physical touchpoints (buttons, lights, haptics, sensors), with mentorship and regular calls with the Finland team.
facts.duties: Design and prototype physical-digital interactions, map user flows with ID, software design and research, support usability testing, and build prototypes in Figma, Arduino or CAD.
facts.requirements: 1–3 years of relevant design experience; portfolio showing physical interface and multisensory interaction work; human factors knowledge; prototyping skills; some travel to Finland and San Diego.
